exposure: prenatal ultrasound score of the placenta
outcome: diagnostic efficacy of ultrasound score, MRI, and their combination to placenta accreta
cohort: 108 pregnant women with suspected placenta accreta
finding: A combination of prenatal ultrasound score of the placenta with MRI was more accurate in diagnosing placenta accreta during the second and third trimester of pregnancy than ultrasound or MRI alone.
